$comment: Single source of truth for Ghostty WASM builds (scripts/build-wasm.sh, scripts/build-legacy-wasm.sh). Moving a pin: change ghosttyCommit, set wasmSha256 to null, build once with --allow-unverified (pin discovery only, never into the repo root, not for release), review, then record the printed sha256. A null wasmSha256 means unverified: normal builds refuse it.

libghostty-vt.description: Shipping engine: upstream libghostty-vt C/WASM API, unpatched.

legacy.description: Pre-migration engine: 5714ed07 + patches/legacy/ghostty-wasm-api.patch (custom ABI, page-zeroing backport of 420de124f).
